conventions.replaces: Replaces the SH-16 contracts, moved to artifacts/architect/.prev-SH-16/api-contracts.json.
conventions.basePath: /api (existing SchoolHub convention, not /api/v1). Fee routes are src/app/api/fees/**/route.ts; the parent route is src/app/api/me/fees/route.ts. (NFR-7)
conventions.handlerPipeline: withHandler → guard from src/server/fees/access.ts → parseQuery/parseBody with schemas from src/lib/validators/fees.ts → one call into src/server/fees/fees-service.ts or reports.ts → ok(data) / paginated(rows, meta) / CSV Response. Envelopes, error mapping and pagination come from src/server/http.ts only. (NFR-7, NFR-9)

guards.read: requireFeeReader() = requireRole('ADMIN','PARENT'). TEACHER and STUDENT get 403 FORBIDDEN. PARENT reads are scoped with parentStudentIds(). (FR-41, FR-45, NFR-4)
guards.adminRead: requireRole('ADMIN'). Used for setup lists, dashboard, aging, exports and family lookups. (FR-45)
guards.write: requireBursar() = ADMIN + isBursar read from the DB on every request; otherwise 403 FORBIDDEN. (FR-5, FR-45)
guards.idScope: Every :id in a path goes through assertCanSeeInvoice/Payment/Student or assertParent. An id outside the caller's scope or one that does not exist returns 404 NOT_FOUND, so there is no existence oracle. (NFR-4)

envelopes.list: { data: T[], meta: { page, pageSize, total } } via paginated(). ?page defaults to 1; ?pageSize defaults to 20 and is clamped to 100 by parsePagination. (NFR-7)
envelopes.csv: text/csv; charset=utf-8 with Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="<name>-<yyyy-MM-dd>.csv". The body is toCsv() from src/server/csv.ts (formula-injection guard). Exports ignore pagination. Money columns are non-negative 2 dp strings. (FR-44)

conventions.money: Money is always a 2-decimal string such as "2235.00", never a JS number, in both requests and responses. Inputs accept a string or number and are parsed to Decimal; there are at most 2 dp and the value is at most 99999999.99. Negative values appear only on discount and adjustment lines. Every response that carries money also carries currency (the ISO 4217 code from SchoolSettings.currency). (NFR-1, FR-35)
conventions.dates: Date-only fields (issueDate, dueDate, scheduledFor) are 'yyyy-MM-dd'. Instants (receivedAt, createdAt, reversedAt, sentAt) are ISO 8601 UTC. 'today' is schoolDateOf(now, SchoolSettings.timezone). (NFR-8)
conventions.freshness: Every fee read (invoices, payments, families, dashboard, aging, exports, /api/me/fees) calls markOverdue(today) before querying, so statuses are never stale. (FR-25)
conventions.audit: Every write audits after commit with before/after values (D-13). Actions are feeItem.create|update|archive, feePlan.create|update, discount.create|update|archive, studentOptionalFee.set, studentDiscount.set, invoice.create|update|delete|issue|adjust|void|remind, payment.create, payment.reverse and user.update (isBursar). GETs are not audited. (NFR-2)
errorPolicy: Zod failure, allocation sum ≠ amount, allocation > balance, adjustment that would leave total < amountPaid or < 0, or a non-optional item in optional-fees → 400 VALIDATION_ERROR. (FR-21, FR-28, D-10)

Overpayment → 400 VALIDATION_ERROR with message exactly "Amount exceeds the family's outstanding balance of <formatMoney(outstanding, currency)>" and details { outstanding }. Nothing is saved. (FR-29)

Wrong invoice state (PATCH/DELETE/issue on a non-DRAFT; adjust/void/remind on anything other than ISSUED/PARTIALLY_PAID/OVERDUE; void with non-reversed allocations; reversing a payment twice) → 409 CONFLICT. (FR-20, FR-21, FR-31, D-11)
Duplicate code (FeeItem.code), duplicate plan (term or annual + grade) and other P2002 conflicts → 409 CONFLICT via withHandler's Prisma mapping. (FR-6, FR-7)
Manual reminder within 24 h of the last MANUAL reminder → 429 RATE_LIMITED, with details { retryAfter: ISO instant }. (FR-38, D-8)
Non-bursar write → 403 FORBIDDEN. Teacher or student on any fee route → 403 FORBIDDEN. Out-of-scope id → 404 NOT_FOUND. (FR-41, FR-45, NFR-4)

endpoints.description: ADMIN read. Lists fee items. Archived items are hidden unless ?includeArchived=true.
Bursar. Creates a fee item. A duplicate code returns 409.
Bursar. Partial update of a fee item. Existing plan lines and invoices are not changed.
Bursar. Sets archivedAt. Archived items cannot be added to new plans or manual invoices but stay on existing ones. Idempotent.
ADMIN read. Lists fee plans with lines and computed total.
Bursar. Creates a plan. termId null means annual. A second plan for the same term+grade, or for the same annual year+grade (partial index, D-3), returns 409.

body.name: string(1..100)
body.lines: { feeItemId: string, amount: Money > 0 }[] (1..50, unique feeItemId, non-archived items)

endpoints.description: Bursar. Replaces the whole plan, including all lines, in one transaction. Invoices already generated are not changed.
ADMIN read. Lists discounts.
Bursar. Creates a discount. PERCENT value must be in 0–100; FIXED value must be > 0.
Bursar. Partial update with the same validation as POST. Existing invoice lines are not changed.
Bursar. Sets archivedAt. Archived discounts are ignored by preview and generation. Idempotent.
ADMIN read. Optional fees assigned to a student for an academic year (defaults to the current year).
Bursar. Replaces the student's optional fees for the year. Every feeItemId must be an optional, non-archived item.
Bursar. Assigns (upserts) one optional fee to every active student in a section for the year. Existing assignments of the same item are overwritten with the new amount.
ADMIN read. Manual discounts assigned to a student for an academic year (defaults to the current year).

data.discounts: { discountId, name, kind, value: Money, note: string | null }[]

endpoints.description: Bursar. Replaces the student's manual discounts for the year. Discounts with an autoRule are rejected with 400.

Bursar. Read-only dry run of generation: one row per non-archived student in the chosen grades, with totals from computeInvoiceTotals. Skipped rows are marked ALREADY_INVOICED (D-7) or NO_PLAN. Nothing is written.

Bursar. Rebuilds the drafts on the server (client totals are never trusted) and writes them in 50-student chunk transactions. When issue=true it also issues each invoice in the same transaction (number, issueDate=today, dueDate=today+plan.dueDays) and notifies parents with fees.invoice_issued after commit. Idempotent: students already invoiced, including through a concurrent run (P2002 on the partial index), come back in skipped.
Fee reader. Paginated invoice list. ADMIN sees all; PARENT sees only invoices of linked children, excluding DRAFT. meta.totals covers the whole filtered set, not just the page.

query.q: string(≤100)? (student name or invoice number, case-insensitive)

endpoints.description: Bursar. Creates a one-off manual invoice (feePlanId null) with free-form lines. It never counts toward the generation skip rule. With issue=true it is issued in the same transaction.

body.lines: { description: string(1..200), amount: Money > 0, feeItemId?: string }[] (1..50)

endpoints.description: Fee reader. Full invoice detail: lines, allocations with receipt numbers (receipt links for FR-22), balance, AuditLog timeline and reminders. A PARENT must have the student linked and cannot see DRAFTs (404).

Bursar, DRAFT only (otherwise 409). Replaces the draft's lines and recomputes subtotal, discountTotal and total. Discount lines are recomputed by the server from the student's discounts, not taken from the client.

body.lines: { description: string(1..200), amount: Money > 0, feeItemId?: string, isOptional?: boolean }[] (1..50)?

endpoints.description: Bursar, DRAFT only (otherwise 409). Hard-deletes the draft and its lines. Issued invoices are voided, never deleted.

Bursar, DRAFT only (otherwise 409). Assigns INV-YYYY-NNNNNN under the DocumentSequence row lock, sets issueDate=today and dueDate=today+dueDays, recomputes status (a 0-total invoice becomes PAID) and notifies parents with fees.invoice_issued after commit.
Bursar. Allowed for ISSUED, PARTIALLY_PAID or OVERDUE with no non-reversed allocations (D-11); otherwise 409. Sets status VOID, voidedAt and voidReason.

Bursar. Allowed for ISSUED, PARTIALLY_PAID or OVERDUE (otherwise 409). Adds a negative isAdjustment line with a reason, recomputes total and status, and returns 400 if the new total would be < amountPaid or < 0 (D-10).

Bursar. Allowed for ISSUED, PARTIALLY_PAID or OVERDUE (otherwise 409). Inserts a MANUAL InvoiceReminder and notifies every linked parent with fees.overdue_reminder. Returns 429 if the last MANUAL reminder was less than 24 h ago (D-8).

ADMIN read (the record-payment page is bursar-only; reading is allowed for any admin). Returns open invoices (ISSUED, PARTIALLY_PAID, OVERDUE) of every child linked to the parent, oldest due first, with balances and a suggested oldest-first allocation for ?amount. :parentId must be a PARENT user (404 otherwise). When a bursar picks a student, the UI uses the existing GET /api/students/:id/parents to find the primary parent and calls this route with that parent's id. No new lookup endpoint is added.

data.invoices: { id, number, studentId, studentName, dueDate, status, total: Money, amountPaid: Money, balance: Money }[]

endpoints.description: Fee reader. Paginated payments. ADMIN sees all; PARENT sees only payments with at least one allocation to a linked child's invoice. Reversed payments are included and flagged.

query.to: yyyy-MM-dd? (≥ from; school-tz days on receivedAt)

endpoints.description: Bursar. One transaction: lock the allocated invoices sorted by id, reload balances, refuse an overpayment against the family's outstanding balance (FR-29), validate the allocations (sum = amount, each 0 < a ≤ balance, every invoice open and belonging to a child of payerParentId), assign RCT-YYYY-NNNNNN, insert the payment and allocations, and recompute each invoice's amountPaid and status. After commit: audit, then notify parents with fees.payment_received linking to /fees/receipts/:id/print. When allocations are omitted the server applies autoAllocate.

body.reference: string(≤100)? (UI warns: never enter card numbers)
body.payerName: string(1..200) (UI defaults to the primary parent's name)

endpoints.description: Fee reader. Payment detail with allocations and amount in words. A PARENT must have at least one allocated invoice belonging to a linked child (404 otherwise).

Bursar. Locks the payment row (FOR UPDATE) and returns 409 if it is already reversed. Otherwise locks the allocated invoices, sets reversedAt, reversedById and reversalReason, and recomputes every affected invoice. Allocation rows are kept; the payment is never deleted.
ADMIN read. KPI values for a term (defaults to the current term) and the weekly collection trend for the last 12 ISO weeks (school tz).

data.trend: { weekStart: yyyy-MM-dd, collected: Money }[] (12 points, zero-filled)

endpoints.description: ADMIN read. Aging buckets over open invoices' balances (days past dueDate in school tz) and the top 10 overdue families, grouped by primary parent and ordered by overdue balance descending.

data.buckets: { bucket: 'current' | '1-30' | '31-60' | '61-90' | '90+', count: number, amount: Money }[] (always 5, in order)
data.topOverdueFamilies: { parentId, parentName, children: string[], invoiceCount: number, overdue: Money, oldestDueDate: yyyy-MM-dd }[] (≤ 10)

endpoints.description: ADMIN read. CSV of every invoice matching the same filters as GET /api/fees/invoices (shared invoiceWhere). Columns: Number, Student, Grade, Section, Term, Status, Issue date, Due date, Total, Paid, Balance, Currency. Filename invoices-<date>.csv.

requestSchema.query: same filters as GET /api/fees/invoices, without page/pageSize

endpoints.description: ADMIN read. CSV of payments. Columns: Receipt, Received at (school tz), Payer, Method, Reference, Amount, Reversed, Reversed at, Reversal reason, Invoices, Currency. Filename payments-<date>.csv.
ADMIN read. CSV of open invoices with their aging bucket. Columns: Number, Student, Primary parent, Due date, Days overdue, Bucket, Balance, Currency. Filename aging-<date>.csv.
PARENT only (others get 403). Everything the /fees page needs, scoped to getAccessibleStudentIds. DRAFT invoices are excluded; VOID invoices are included so the UI can show them greyed out.

EXISTING endpoint, extended. updateUserSchema gains isBursar: boolean?, mirroring isSafeguardingLead: only an ADMIN caller may set it, only on an ADMIN target (otherwise 400), and the change is audited by the existing updateUser path. No new route.

body.isBursar: boolean? (new field; all other fields unchanged)

pages.note: Server-rendered pages call the same service functions directly and run the same guards (requirePageRole + assertCanSee*). They are listed so dev-planning can trace them; they are not HTTP APIs. (NFR-4)

nonHttpContracts.name: maintenance hooks
nonHttpContracts.location: src/server/fees/maintenance.ts, called from src/app/api/internal/email/dispatch/route.ts (existing secret-protected route, no new endpoint)
nonHttpContracts.signature: markOverdue(today: string): Promise<{ updated: number }>; sendInvoiceReminders(now: Date): Promise<{ sent: number, skipped: number }>
nonHttpContracts.behaviour: markOverdue does one updateMany, setting ISSUED/PARTIALLY_PAID with dueDate < today to OVERDUE. sendInvoiceReminders, for each open invoice with a reminderSlot, inserts an InvoiceReminder (a P2002 means it was already sent, so skip) and then notifies every linked parent. Delivery is at most once. The dispatch route response gains a fees: { overdue, remindersSent } key.

fees.overdue_reminder.params: { invoiceNumber, studentName, balance, dueDate, kind: InvoiceReminderKind, currency }

nonHttpContracts.name: KPI and overview extensions
nonHttpContracts.contract: getKpis payload gains outstandingFees: { amount: Money, currency } from reports.outstandingTotal(). The per-child overview gains fees: { outstanding: Money, currency, href: '/fees' } | null (null when the balance is 0). GET /api/dashboard/admin therefore gains the same key, an additive change.

nonHttpContracts.name: pure fee math
nonHttpContracts.contract: computeInvoiceTotals, siblingRank, siblingRuleFor, autoAllocate, validateAllocations, deriveStatus, reminderSlot, agingBucket, formatMoney, amountInWords, as specified in system-design §2.2–2.3. Used by routes, the client AllocationEditor, the seed and the tests.
